auth.description: Split screen login with interactive neural animation, glowing node graph preview, quick role switcher pills (admin@demo.com / faculty@demo.com) and glassmorphism form card.

dashboard.description: Comprehensive institutional intelligence view: 4 KPI summary cards (Total Students, Mean CGPA, At-Risk Population, Intervention Success Rate) with sparklines; Attendance & CGPA 8-semester trend curves; 5-tier Risk Distribution Donut; Department cross-comparison matrix; Interactive Risk Heatmap; Live real-time alerts ticker; Top prioritized students list.

students_list.description: Dense data table with instant search (name, roll no, email), multi-select department filter (CSE, ECE, MECH, CIVIL, IT), semester slider, risk level pills, status indicators, sorting, pagination, and direct link to Student 360 profile.

student_360.description: Deep individual student audit: Hero header with avatar, roll number, department badge, current risk status; Live composite score circular gauge (Academic, Attendance, LMS Engagement, Placement Readiness, Behavioral); SHAP/Explainable AI factor breakdown (positive and negative contributors); Longitudinal semester trend lines; Prescriptive faculty action plan & 1-click intervention trigger.

scoring_engine.description: Pure modular scoring algorithm computing weighted composite readiness index, normalized percentiles, and dynamic trend direction.

risk_engine.description: Multi-variable risk engine evaluating attendance drops, academic decline, low portal engagement, and arrears backlog into 4 distinct tiers.

explainable_ai.description: Feature attribution simulator providing transparent mathematical reasons for each student's risk rating with impact weights.

recommendation_engine.description: Generates tailored pedagogical and mentoring interventions based on identified weaknesses.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: #0B0B14 background, #12121F surfaces, #C4B5FD primary accent, #A78BFA secondary, #7C3AED deep glow.
Do NOT use pure #000000 backgrounds. Retain the deep cosmic purple tint #0B0B14.
All cards must have subtle rounded corners (rounded-2xl) and 1px delicate borders: border-[#C4B5FD]/15.
Header and dropdown menus MUST NOT have a transparent background. Use solid or heavily blurred surfaces like bg-[#12121F]/95 with backdrop-blur-xl.

Every interactive element (buttons, filters, inputs, table rows, tab triggers, modal buttons) MUST include an explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='student-search-input', data-testid='login-submit-button').
Charts must use Recharts with responsive containers, custom tooltips styled in dark purple glass, and subtle gradients (accent light purple and cyan).
Provide a quick demo credential autofill button on the Login page for both Admin and Faculty to make review seamless.
Faculty role must automatically filter views and mock data to their assigned department (e.g. CSE), while Admin sees all 5 departments.
